candidates.change_summary: Replace OR condition with AND to break the interface check logic.
Remove the check for IAccessControl interface, only delegating to super.
Hardcode return to false, breaking all interface support.
Replace the function body to return false unconditionally, ignoring stored role membership.
Replace the function body to return true unconditionally, ignoring stored role membership.
Return a constant bytes32 value instead of the actual adminRole from storage.
Replace the require statement that checks account == _msgSender() with require(true, ...) to allow any account to renounce roles for any other account.
Remove the require statement entirely so that renounceRole can be called by anyone to revoke any account's role.
Replace the require statement with require(false, ...) to make renounceRole always revert, preventing any role renunciation.
Remove the call to _revokeRole so that renounceRole executes successfully but never actually revokes the role.
